rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: Steady large-cap drug maker with positive earnings momentum. It is within 6% of its 52-week high and moves less than the market.
rows.risks: Pricing pressure and the approaching loss of patent protection on Keytruda.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: Leading US steelmaker with high profit margins thanks to tariff protection and a strong balance sheet.
rows.risks: Steel prices could fall if industrial demand slows.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: Natural gas pipeline and processing company whose fees grow with Permian Basin volumes. It swings less than the refiners.
rows.risks: Lower drilling activity if oil prices fall further.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: Category leader in cybersecurity software with durable subscription growth. The 18% pullback from its high looks like the sector selloff, not a problem specific to the company.
rows.risks: A high valuation leaves it exposed if the tech selloff continues.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: Refiner that returns a lot of cash to shareholders through buybacks and is still 36% above its 200-day average after a strong year.
rows.risks: Refining profit margins could normalize faster than expected.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: The company simplified its structure after its split, and its recovery is continuing. The stock is up 20% in a month.
rows.risks: Weak industrial demand and costs tied to PFAS chemical litigation.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: Cheap generic drug maker with improving momentum; it is at a 52-week high.
rows.risks: Generic drug price erosion and the debt it carries.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: Low-cost refiner with strong free cash flow. The 20% drop from its high leaves the valuation reasonable.
rows.risks: Refining profit margins could keep falling.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Storage company tied to AI data demand. After a 23% pullback it is cheaply valued ahead of its results.
rows.risks: Its next earnings guidance could confirm a slowdown in hardware spending.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Electronic test equipment maker with a strong sales pipeline; the stock rebounded 7% last week ahead of its fiscal Q4 report.
rows.risks: A cautious outlook in the late-November report.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Wealth management brings in steady fees, and investment banking and trading activity is recovering.
rows.risks: A market downturn would hit both its asset management fees and its trading.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Third-quarter revenue grew 20%, and it has raised full-year billings guidance three times this year, so the 33% drop in a month looks overdone.
rows.risks: It is very volatile and could keep falling with the rest of cybersecurity.

rows.name: Humana
rows.thesis: Its 2027 Medicare star ratings improved, which should restore earnings growth; it is at a 52-week high with low volatility.
rows.risks: Rising medical costs for Medicare Advantage members.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Beat third-quarter estimates and raised full-year guidance; the post-earnings selloff looks like profit-taking after a big run.
rows.risks: Weak spending by research customers, and the consensus analyst price target is below the current price.
